# Whispers in the Court - THE RULER'S ORDERS.
# GENERATED by the patch in tools/ - see docs/ARCHITETTURA.md.
#
# What the player decides in person (said outright in a conversation, or a
# button pressed in the side panel). No court influence is spent - the
# decision is the ruler's - but it is never free: every order that takes
# effect costs the realm something (stability, prestige, government power)
# like the real act would. The engine's own conditions are checked first;
# if one fails, nothing happens and the next day an event says exactly why.
#
# No effect here reads a variable it wrote: EU5 does not let an effect see
# its own writes, so conditions only look at the world as it already was.

# war (cb = 1..8)
votc_order_war = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = var:votc_tcountry
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = var:votc_tcountry }
			NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = var:votc_tcountry } }
			NOT = { has_truce_with = var:votc_tcountry }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = var:votc_tcountry }
			knows_country = var:votc_tcountry
		}
		votc_war_cb_$cb$ = yes
		# Against a declared rival (either way) the realm expects the war: no price for declaring it.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_rival_of = var:votc_tcountry }
				NOT = { var:votc_tcountry = { is_rival_of = root } }
			}
			add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
		}
		votc_war_cost_$cb$ = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail_what value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = var:votc_tcountry } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = var:votc_tcountry } } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = var:votc_tcountry } } } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 3 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { NOT = { has_truce_with = var:votc_tcountry } } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 4 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { NOT = { is_subject_of = var:votc_tcountry } } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 5 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { knows_country = var:votc_tcountry } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 6 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 11 } }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = votc.910 days = 1 }
	}
}

# peace
votc_order_peace = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = var:votc_tcountry
			is_at_war_with = var:votc_tcountry
		}
		leave_all_wars_with = var:votc_tcountry
		add_truce_with = { target = var:votc_tcountry mutual = yes years = 5 }
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail_what value = 2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = var:votc_tcountry } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = var:votc_tcountry } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 7 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 11 } }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = votc.910 days = 1 }
	}
}

# alliance
votc_order_alliance = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = var:votc_tcountry
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = var:votc_tcountry }
			NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = var:votc_tcountry } }
			knows_country = var:votc_tcountry
		}
		create_relation = { first = this second = var:votc_tcountry type = relation_type:alliance }
		add_government_power = government_power_weak_penalty
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail_what value = 3 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = var:votc_tcountry } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = var:votc_tcountry } } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = var:votc_tcountry } } } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 3 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { knows_country = var:votc_tcountry } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 6 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 11 } }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = votc.910 days = 1 }
	}
}

# break_alliance
votc_order_break_alliance = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = var:votc_tcountry
			is_allied_with = { target = var:votc_tcountry }
		}
		remove_relation = { first = this second = var:votc_tcountry type = relation_type:alliance }
		var:votc_tcountry = { add_opinion = { target = root modifier = votc_opinion_broken_promise } }
		add_trust = { target = var:votc_tcountry value = -20 }
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty
		add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail_what value = 4 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = var:votc_tcountry } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = var:votc_tcountry } } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 9 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 11 } }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = votc.910 days = 1 }
	}
}

# access
votc_order_access = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = var:votc_tcountry
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = var:votc_tcountry }
			knows_country = var:votc_tcountry
		}
		create_relation = { first = var:votc_tcountry second = this type = relation_type:military_access }
		add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail_what value = 6 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = var:votc_tcountry } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = var:votc_tcountry } } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { knows_country = var:votc_tcountry } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 6 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 11 } }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = votc.910 days = 1 }
	}
}

# claim (cb = 1..8)
votc_order_claim = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = var:votc_tcountry
			knows_country = var:votc_tcountry
		}
		votc_claim_cb_$cb$ = yes
		add_government_power = government_power_mild_penalty
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail_what value = 7 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = var:votc_tcountry } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { knows_country = var:votc_tcountry } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 6 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 11 } }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = votc.910 days = 1 }
	}
}

# truce
votc_order_truce = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = var:votc_tcountry
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = var:votc_tcountry }
		}
		add_truce_with = { target = var:votc_tcountry mutual = yes years = 5 }
		add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail_what value = 8 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = var:votc_tcountry } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = var:votc_tcountry } } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 2 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 11 } }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = votc.910 days = 1 }
	}
}

# submission
votc_order_submission = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = var:votc_tcountry
			is_at_war_with = var:votc_tcountry
			var:votc_tcountry = { is_subject = no }
			var:votc_tcountry = { army_size < root.votc_c_army_third num_locations < root.votc_c_locations_half }
		}
		leave_all_wars_with = var:votc_tcountry
		var:votc_tcountry = { make_subject_of = { target = root type = subject_type:vassal } }
		# A realm brought under the crown: the realm takes pride in it.
		add_government_power = government_power_weak_penalty
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail_what value = 9 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = var:votc_tcountry } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = var:votc_tcountry } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 7 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { var:votc_tcountry = { is_subject = no } } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 10 } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { var:votc_tcountry = { army_size < root.votc_c_army_third num_locations < root.votc_c_locations_half } } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 8 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 11 } }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = votc.910 days = 1 }
	}
}

# A weaker realm that AGREES to come under the ruler's crown, without a war (a free town's
# submission, a lordship buying protection): it becomes a vassal, keeping its own government.
# Court Brain orders it only when that court would really consent (app._would_accept).
votc_order_vassalage = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = var:votc_tcountry
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = var:votc_tcountry }
			var:votc_tcountry = { is_subject = no }
			var:votc_tcountry = { num_locations < root.votc_c_locations }
		}
		var:votc_tcountry = { make_subject_of = { target = root type = subject_type:vassal } }
		# A realm brought under the crown: the realm takes pride in it.
		add_government_power = government_power_weak_penalty
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail_what value = 13 }
		votc_order_union_why = yes
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = votc.910 days = 1 }
	}
}

# A small realm that agrees to become part of the ruler's realm outright: its lands become the
# ruler's (cores kept, as in a cession) and it ceases to be. Only a realm much smaller than the
# ruler's, not at war with it, and no one else's subject (or already the ruler's own).
votc_order_union = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = var:votc_tcountry
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = var:votc_tcountry }
			var:votc_tcountry = { OR = { is_subject = no is_subject_of = root } }
			var:votc_tcountry = { num_locations <= root.votc_c_locations_half }
		}
		var:votc_tcountry = {
			every_owned_location = {
				remove_core = owner
				change_location_owner = root
				add_core = root
			}
		}
		add_government_power = government_power_weak_penalty
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail_what value = 14 }
		votc_order_union_why = yes
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = votc.910 days = 1 }
	}
}

votc_order_union_why = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = var:votc_tcountry } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_at_war_with = var:votc_tcountry } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 17 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { var:votc_tcountry = { OR = { is_subject = no is_subject_of = root } } } } set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 10 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = votc_order_fail value = 18 } }
}

# War and claims by casus belli (the textual $cb$ picks one).
votc_war_cb_1 = { declare_war_with_cb = { target = var:votc_tcountry type = casus_belli:cb_war_from_event } }
votc_war_cb_2 = { declare_war_with_cb = { target = var:votc_tcountry type = casus_belli:cb_insulted_us } }
votc_war_cb_3 = { declare_war_with_cb = { target = var:votc_tcountry type = casus_belli:cb_claim_throne } }
votc_war_cb_4 = { declare_war_with_cb = { target = var:votc_tcountry type = casus_belli:cb_humiliate } }
votc_war_cb_5 = { declare_war_with_cb = { target = var:votc_tcountry type = casus_belli:cb_religious_conformance } }
votc_war_cb_6 = { declare_war_with_cb = { target = var:votc_tcountry type = casus_belli:cb_trade_conflict } }
votc_war_cb_7 = { declare_war_with_cb = { target = var:votc_tcountry type = casus_belli:cb_border_war } }
votc_war_cb_8 = { declare_war_with_cb = { target = var:votc_tcountry type = casus_belli:cb_subjugation } }
votc_claim_cb_2 = { add_casus_belli = { target = var:votc_tcountry type = casus_belli:cb_insulted_us } }
votc_claim_cb_3 = { add_casus_belli = { target = var:votc_tcountry type = casus_belli:cb_claim_throne } }
votc_claim_cb_4 = { add_casus_belli = { target = var:votc_tcountry type = casus_belli:cb_humiliate } }
votc_claim_cb_5 = { add_casus_belli = { target = var:votc_tcountry type = casus_belli:cb_religious_conformance } }
votc_claim_cb_6 = { add_casus_belli = { target = var:votc_tcountry type = casus_belli:cb_trade_conflict } }
votc_claim_cb_7 = { add_casus_belli = { target = var:votc_tcountry type = casus_belli:cb_border_war } }
votc_claim_cb_8 = { add_casus_belli = { target = var:votc_tcountry type = casus_belli:cb_subjugation } }
votc_claim_cb_1 = { add_casus_belli = { target = var:votc_tcountry type = casus_belli:cb_insulted_us } }

# A war with no real grievance shakes the realm more than one with a cause.
votc_war_cost_1 = { add_stability = stability_weak_penalty }
votc_war_cost_2 = { }
votc_war_cost_3 = { }
